name: motion-handheld-drift
title: Handheld Drift
description: Cả khung trôi chậm không đều như máy quay cầm tay, biên độ rất nhỏ.

moworks.author: takayu

options.amp: px scale of the sines (9: x = 18 sin 1.7t + 9 sin 3.1t, y = 12 sin 2.3t + 6 sin 4.7t)

credit.author: TakayuStudio (motion-reference)
credit.licence: No licence stated: idea and numbers only
credit.madeNote: written here from the idea and its numbers; none of the source's code

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio cam-handheld, written here): Full-frame group offset by a sum of sines: recipe x = sum a_i sin(2 pi t / T_i), T 1.7 / 2.9 / 4.3 s, amplitude 2-4 px. Demo: x = 6 sin(1.7 t) + 3 sin(3.1 t), y = 4 sin(2.3 t) + 2 sin(4.7 t) px, roll 0.01 sin(1.3 t) rad, scale 1.05 to hide the edges. Params: amp (2–4 px) · periods (1.7 / 2.9 / 4.3 s) · overscan (1.05).
moworks.titleVi: Rung nhẹ như cầm máy tay
